name: Keith Avenue
credit: Laid out by hand from reference photos of the real street (positions are approximate)

look.comment: The street's general look: 1980s/90s Scottish suburb on a slope. Harled (roughcast) walls, white to beige, with red-brown brick bases; concrete tile roofs in dark grey or red-brown, mostly hipped; brown timber/uPVC windows; front lawns, block-paved or gravel drives, timber fences; tall grey lamp posts; a dark conifer wood on the hill behind.
look.backdrop: dense dark conifer woodland on the rising ground behind the houses
